tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mgon chos sogs kyi gtor 'bul bskang gso dang bcas pa bzhugs/

na mo badz+ra bhai ra wa ye/ 'dir chos skyong 'ga' zhig gi gtor 'bul 'khyer bde bar brjod pa la/ lha'i rnal 'byor sngar bsgoms pa yod na de'i ngang nas sam/ yang na gsang bde 'jigs gsum gang rung du skad cig gis bskyed nas byin brlabs rang rang gi lugs ltar ram/ bsdus pa 'dod na logs su bkod pa yang rung la de nas yul spyan drangs pa yod na de dang bstun cing*/ med na 'di ltar/ dzaḥrang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /bsil ba'i tshal dad gshin rje'i grong khyer nas/ /ye shes mgon po dam can chos kyi rgyal/ / 'khor bcas spyan drangs mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /mu li gting dang lcang lo can sogs nas/ /'dod khams dbang phyug rgyal chen rnams thos sras/ /rta bdag brgyad dang tha 'og chos rgyal sogs/ /'khor bcas spyan drangs 'dir gshegs rten la bzhugs/ /bde stong dbyer med rol ba las byung ba'i/ / mchod yon zhabs bsil nyer spyod rnam pa lnga/ /'dod yon rgyal srid rta g.yag lug bya khyi/ /gling bzhi nyi zla ri rab bcas te 'bul/ /khyad par rab yangs thod par 'bru bcud dang*/ /dgra bgegs sha khrag rus gsum las byung ba'i/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i gtor ma'i rgya mtsho 'di/ /chos skyong 'khor bcas 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol/ /thugs mchog zhi ba'i dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar mdzad ye shes mgon/ /chos kyi rgyal po dmag zor rgyal mo dang*/ /rnam sras tha 'og chos rgyal 'khor bcas bstod/ /khyed rnams mchod cing bstod bskul gsol btab pas/ /rnal 'byor sbyin bdag 'dus sde dgon gnas kyi/ /'gal kyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ /mthun rkyen 'dod rgu yid bzhin sgrub par mdzod/ /nyes kun bzod bzhes rang rang rten rnams dang*/ /dbyer med bzhugs nas rnal 'byor bdag cag kun/ /dus rnams rtag tu bsrung zhing skyob pa dang*/ /'dod don yid bzhin sgrub pa'i 'phrin las

mdzod/ /rten med na/ badz+ra muḥgator mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /ces pa 'di yang*/ rgyud pa'i dbang mdzad pa dang*/ dge bskos rnam pa gnyis kyis gtor 'bul 'jug pa bde ched 'di ltar zhig gis dang*/ rgyud pa grwa tshang gi zhal 'don du 'jug par bya'o/ /zhes bskul pa la brten nas rgyud pa'i slob dpon bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba'o/ /na mo ma hā kā la ye/ mgon po phyag drug pa la mchod gtor bya tshul 'jug pa bde bar 'god pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhes pa nas skur bzhengs par gyur par bsams la/ nang mchod dang mchod gtor rnams bcu gsum ma ltar byin gyis rlabs pa'am/ bsdu na/ rang nyid 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis par/ /gsal ba'i thugs kha'i hūṃ las 'od phros pas/ /mchod rdzas kun gyi nyes pa'i skyon sbyangs nas/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum las gcig / spyan 'dren ni/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ /shar lho bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod nas/ /dpal ldan ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa/ /'dod khams dbang phyug k+ṣe ṭa pā la sogs/ /'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i dpung dang lhan cig tu/ /rnal 'byor 'phrin las bsgrub phyir skad cig gis/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs myur byon nas/ /rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /phyag 'tshal ni/ rnam dag chos sku'i dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /ma rung 'dul phyir khros pa'i gar mdzad pa/ /zhal gcig phyag drug bstan dgra tshar gcod sku/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bshags pa ni/ thog ma med nas bsags pa'i nyes kun dang*/ /khyad par bla ma mgon po 'khor bcas kyi/ /sku gsung thugs dang 'gal bar rab spyod pa'i/ /dam tshig nyams chags thams cad so sor bshags/ /mchod pa ni/ bla ma mchog gsum chos dbyings bden pa dang*/

/ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya'i byin brlabs kyis/ /phyi nang mchod tshogs sa gzhi bar snang dang*/ /nam mkha' khyon kun ma lus 'gengs gyur cig khrag gi mchod yon dbang po'i me tog dang*/ /sha chen tshil dud zhun chen sgron me dang*/ /sha rus zhal zas rkang gling rol mo 'dis/ /mgon po 'khor bcas mchod cing thugs dam bskang*/ /myur mgyogs rta mchog zhol chen g.yag rog dang*/ /lug nag spyi dkar khyung 'dra'i bya nag dang*/ /dom lta'i khyi nag 'jigs pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /mgon po 'khor bcas= /gzhan yang 'dod yon lnga dang rin chen bdun/ /rdo rje'i go khrab mda' ldan gtor chen dang*/ /ri gling nyi zla phyi nang mchod sprin gyis/ /mgon po 'khor= khyad par sha khrag 'bru bcud gtor ma'i tshogs/ /zag med ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs nas/ /myur mdzad ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas kun/ /dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol/ /bstod pa dang 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ /rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje gcig bsdus pa'i/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang drag po'i skur bstan pa/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa yongs rdzogs mthu rtsal can/ /ye shes mgon po 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /yang na/ mthu stobs nus pa 'phrin las phun tshogs shing nas/ ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas bstod par bgyi/ khyed rnams mchod cing bstod pas bdag cag gi /'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ /tshe dpal longs spyod snyan grags 'dod rgu bcas/ /mthun rkyen ma lus yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /rten yod na/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu/ zhes sogs bya la/ med na/ nyes byas bzod bzhes rang bzhin gnas su gshegs/ /dus su byon nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /bar chad sel zhing rtag tu srung skyob dang*/ /phyogs rnams kun du bkra shis 'phel bar mdzod/ /ces pa 'di ni/ bkra shis 'phel rgyas gling gi dgon sde'i spyi ba thun mong gi nan tan du bskul ba'i ngor shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba'o/

/na mo badz+ra bhe ra wa ye/ rang nyid 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis par/ /gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /mchod gtor kun gyi nyes pa'i skyon sbyangs nas/ /zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum mam gcig /rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer tshogs/ / rab 'phros lho phyogs gshin rje'i grong khyer nas/ /las kyi gshin rje yab yum 'khor dang bcas/ /spyan drangs mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ / gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor bcas khyed rnams la/ /mchod yon nyer spyod 'dod yon nang mchod dang*/ /dgra bgegs sha khrag 'bru bcud las grub pa'i/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'bul gyis bzhes/ /'di rang gsum mam gcig /rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jam dpal zhi khro yi/ /bka' sdod thub bstan srung ma kun gyi gtso/ /dgra bgegs thal bar rlog pa'i mthu rtsal can/ /gshin rje kun gyi rgyal po khyod la bstod/ /mthu chen khyed la mchod cing bstod byas pas/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag mi nor 'khor bcas kyi/ /phyi nang mi mthun nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing*/ /rtag tu mthun rkyen bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig / gshegs gsol byed na/ badz+ra muḥgator mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ /ces brjod kyang cho ga la brtan bzhugs byed na/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu/ nas legs par stsal du gsol/ zhes byas kyang mi 'gal lo/ / ces pa 'di yang*/ gnas brtan grags pa 'od zer gyis rang gi zhal 'don gyi ched du bskul ba'i ngor bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba'o/ /bkra shis// //༈ na mo badz+ra pā ṇi ye/ 'dir rgyal chen rnam sras 'khor bcas la gtor 'bul dang*/ bsang mchod sogs byed tshul mdor bsdus zhig 'chad pa la/ skyabs sems sogs sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal phyag na rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal bar gyur par bsams la/ mchod gtor bsang mchod rnams byin brlab bya tshul la rgyas bsdus gnyis las/

rgyas pa ni byin brlabs so sor bya ba yin na'ang*/ 'dir bsdu na/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod gtor dang bsang chen gyi ri bos sa dang bar snang gi khyon thams cad gang zhing mgron rnams kyi dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag med kyi bde ba khyad par can bskyed par byed pa'i nus ldan du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ gtor ma dang bsang gnyis las gang rung zhig yin na/ de'i tshig sbyor bya/ de nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros te/ /byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas/ /rgyal chen rnam sras nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas/ /spyan drangs mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ /gser gyi ri dbang lta bur brjid chags shing*/ /nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi byin rab tu 'bar/ /yo byad nam mkha' mdzod la dbang bsgyur ba/ /rgyal chen rnam sras 'khor dang bcas la 'dud/ /mchod 'bul ni/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo 'dod yon lnga/ /rin chen bdun dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad dang*/ /gling bzhi ri rab bdag lus longs spyod bcas/ /rgyal chen rnam sras 'khor dang bcas pa 'bul/ / gtor 'bul ni/ dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bru bcud dang sbyar ba'i/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i gtor ma'i rgya mtsho 'di/ /rgyal chen rnam sras 'khor bcas la 'bul gyis/ /bzhes nas 'dod rgu'i dngos grub char ltar phob/ /bsang mchod ni/ dri ldan bzang sman shing sna bsregs pa las/ /byung ba'i bsang chen dud pa chu 'dzin bzhin/ /nam mkha'i khams kun yongs su khyab byas te/ /rgya chen rnam sras 'khor bcas mchod par bgyi/ /khyad par phyi yi mchod pa ni/

gzhan yang dgos 'dod nor dang dpag bsam shing*/ /rin chen ljon shing gter bum bzang po dang*/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang rdzing bu bzang po sogs/ /rgyal chen rnam sras 'khor bcas mnyes phyir 'bul/ /gos sngon lung thang phreng ba ne'u le dang*/ /mi 'jigs seng ge rgyal mtshan nyi ma zla/ /'bru sman rin chen snying po lnga la sogs/ /rgyal chen rnam sras 'khor bcas mnyes phyir 'bul/ /sbyin gtor rgya mtsho'i dge la goms byas pas/ /mi 'dzad gter gyi dpal la dbang bsgyur zhing*/ /phongs pa kun la 'dod rgu'i mchog ster ba/ /rgyal chen rnam sras 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ khyed la mchod cing gus pas bstod byas pas/ /mi 'dod dbul ba'i rgud pa sel byed cing*/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub ma lus stsol ba dang*/ /rtag tu srung zhing skyob pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ rten yod na/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu/ zhes sogs dang*/ med na/ badz+ra muḥ mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam mo/ /ces pa 'di yang dad dang rnam dpyod ldan pa'i brtson 'grus phun tshogs zhes bgyi bas/ rnam sras rang gi brten pa'i lhar bab pas mchod tshul 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar bshad sgrub ming can gyi sbyar ba'o/ /bkra shis// //༈ na mo badz+ra bhe wa ra ye/ 'dir 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshegs kyi bka' sngon chos kyi rgyal po 'khor bcas la gtor 'bul mdor bsdus 'khyer bde zhig brjod par bya ste/ byin rlabs bcu gsum ma ltar ram bsdu na/ rang nyid 'jigs mdzad zhal gcig phyag gnyis par/ /gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /mchod gtor kun gyi nyes pa'i skyon sbyangs nas/ /zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum mam gcig de nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ gis 'od zer gyis/ /lho phyogs gshin rje'i grong khyer chen po nas/ /las kyi gshin rje yum mchog tsa muṇ+ḍi/

/'khor bcas spyan drangs brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /mchod yon nyer spyod rol mo 'dod yon sogs/ /phyi nang mchod sprin nam mkha' gang ba dang*/ khyad par zag med sha khrag gtor ma'i tshogs/ /chos rgyal 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul/ /pad nyi dgra bgegs ma he'i gdan gyi steng*/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gtum drag khros pa'i sku/ /bstan dgra tshar gcod brkyang bskums 'gyings stabs can/ /ma lus dgra bgegs dpung 'joms khyod la bstod/ /stobs chen khyod la mchod cing bstod byas pas/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dgon gnas sbyin bdag bcas/ /g.yas med rtag srung 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang*/ /mthun rkyen mtha' dag yid bzhin sgrub par mdzod/ /mdor bsdus la brtan bzhugs dang gshegs gsol gang byed kyi rnam dbye re zhig bzhag go /ces pa 'di ni rgyud pa'i byang 'dren dge slong brtson 'grus dar rgyas zhes bgyi bas gtor 'bul 'di lta bu zhig kho bos spar du brkos nas rgyud pa'i tshogs 'don du 'jug e thub blta zhes bskul ba la brten nas rgyud pa'i slob dpon pa bshad sgrub ming can gyis 'phral du sbyar ba'o/ /maṅgalaṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/mgon chos sogs kyi gtor 'bul bskang gso dang bcas pa bzhugs/ -PAGE 302--PAGE 303--PAGE 296-
